stem: Reese needs to improve the introduction of his essay. Which sentence should be added before sentence 1 to create a more effective introduction for his essay?

options.label: A
options.text: There are so many mysteries about the human body that you would never believe it.

options.label: B
options.text: The brain is like the body's big jigsaw puzzle.

options.label: C
options.text: Over the past centuries, many of the mysteries of the human body have been explained by science.

options.label: D
options.text: Scientists are determined to find out all the facts that can help them understand our world.
